description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git diff' commands, including various options and formats. It sets up test cases, runs 'git diff-files', compares outputs against expected results, and verifies behavior for different diff formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success; runs commands and compares results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that given output is empty.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares actual diff output against expected.
